en.t: He stepped down from the carriage.

units.source_text: 惟光用马鞭拂除草上的露水，走在前面引路。

en.t: Koremitsu brushed the dew from the grass with his riding whip and walked ahead to guide the way.

units.source_text: 但树木上水点纷纷落下，像秋天的霖雨一般，随从者便替公子撑伞。

en.t: But drops of water kept falling from the trees like an autumn drizzle, so an attendant held an umbrella over the young lord.

units.source_text: 惟光说：“真如‘东歌’所谓‘敬告贵人请加笠，树下水点比雨密’了。”

en.t: Koremitsu said, "It is just as the Azuma song says: respectfully tell the noble one to put on a hat, for the drops beneath the trees are thicker than rain."

units.source_text: 源氏公子的裙裾全被露水湿透。

en.t: The hem of Prince Genji's robe was completely soaked with dew.

units.source_text: 那中门从前早就坍损得不成样子，现在竟已形迹全无。

en.t: The middle gate had already fallen into ruin long before, and now even its traces had vanished completely.

units.source_text: 走进里面一看，更是大杀风景。

en.t: When they went inside and looked around, the scene was even more disheartening.

units.source_text: 此时源氏公子的狼狈相，幸而没有外人看见，还可放心。

en.t: Fortunately, no outsider saw Prince Genji looking so bedraggled at that moment, so he could still feel at ease.
